title: Align, Then Adapt: Few-Shot fMRI Visual Reconstruction For New Subjects
abstract: arXiv:2505.01670v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reconstructing visual images from fMRI data is a central but challenging problem in neuroscience. Despite recent progress, current methods fall short when data and computation are limited-precisely the conditions under which this task is most critical. We introduce Adapter Alignment, a staged, architecture-agnostic training procedure for adapting a pre-trained reconstruction model to a new subject with little data. Rather than letting a shared representation space emerge implicitly, lightweight subject-specific adapters are first explicitly aligned to a pre-trained reference subject on a small set of shared calibration images, and the full pipeline is then fine-tuned while preserving this alignment. The resulting representations not only place different subjects in a shared space but also align them semantically. translated_title: 先对齐，再适配：面向新被试的少样本fMRI视觉重建
translated_abstract: 从fMRI数据重建视觉图像是神经科学中一个核心但极具挑战性的问题。尽管近期已有诸多进展，现有方法在数据和计算资源受限时表现不佳——而这恰恰是该任务最为关键的应用场景。我们提出了Adapter Alignment（适配器对齐），这是一种分阶段的、与架构无关的训练流程，用于在数据量极少的情况下将预训练的重建模型适配到新被试。与让共享表征空间隐式涌现的做法不同，该方法首先在一小批共享校准图像上，将轻量级的被试专属适配器显式对齐到一个预训练的参考被试，然后在保持这种对齐的前提下对整个流程进行微调。由此得到的表征不仅能将不同被试置于同一共享空间中，还能实现语义层面的对齐。我们的结果表明，该方法在低数据量情形下取得了显著收益，重建指标最高提升了8%。
tldr: 提出一种分阶段的Adapter Alignment训练流程，先将轻量级被试专属适配器显式对齐到预训练参考被试、再在保持对齐的情况下整体微调，从而在少样本低数据条件下将新被试的fMRI视觉重建指标最高提升8%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Adapter Alignment, a staged, architecture-agnostic training procedure that first explicitly aligns lightweight subject-specific adapters to a pre-trained reference subject and then fine-tunes the full pipeline, boosting few-shot fMRI visual reconstruction for new subjects by up to 8% in low-data regimes.
